Fieldwork

Find the problem before the pitch deck.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems and work with the community, with a mentor checking the work along the way. Customers are often closer than the investors.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Building toward a startup of your own? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students study real problems in their neighbourhood with the community, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
